blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reliable retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires recognizing when neither retrieved documents nor parametric knowledge supports an answer. We introduce DeclineCraft, a dynamic abstention benchmark whose unanswerable questions target Minecraft feature additions after a corpus cut-off, with audits of possible parametric exposure. Later cut-offs support evaluation of future models. Across 27 LLMs, we measure Correct Abstention Rate (CAR; how often models acknowledge insufficient knowledge on unanswerable questions), Answerable Attempt Rate and Answer Accuracy. We find that (1) single-shot retrieval significantly raises CAR in 38 of 40 configurations (model and thinking setting) versus no retrieval. (2) Iterative RAG, in which the model self-assesses its context and can request up to two further retrieval rounds, significantly lowers CAR versus single-shot RAG in 30 of 40 configurations (mean 46.4%), with little change in Answer Accuracy (68.5% to 69.3%). Adding query rewriting and reranking to hybrid (dense & sparse) retrieval lowers CAR for all 12 models tested. (3) Larger models answer more accurately (Spearman $ρ= +0.60$ with total parameters), but neither model size nor release date shows a significant association with CAR. (4) Without retrieval, enabling thinking on the same weights lowers CAR significantly for 8 of 13 models (by 14% points on average), and the responses shift from acknowledged uncertainty to premise denial.
blocks.zh: 可靠的检索增强生成(RAG)要求当检索到的文件或参数化知识都不支持答案时予以确认。 我们引入了DecuteCraft,这是一个动态弃权基准,其无法回答的问题针对Minecraft公司,其特点是在命案断断后增加,并审计可能的参数暴露。 后来的断层支持对未来模型的评价. 在27个法学课程中,我们衡量正确留学率(CAR;模型如何经常承认对无法回答的问题了解不足)、可回答的尝试率和答案准确性。 我们认为,(1) 单发检索在40个配置(模型和思维设定)中的38个中大大提高了CAR,而不是检索。 (2) 惯性RAG,其中模型自定义其上下文,并可要求最多再进行两轮检索,大大降低了CAR相对于40个配置中的30个组合的单发RAG(平均46.4%),而Answer精确度变化不大(68.5%至69.3%). 将查询重写和重排添加到混合( dense & short) 检索中, 降低所有12个测试模型的 CAR 。 (3)较大的模型回答更准确(Spearman $ρ=+0.60美元有总参数),但模型大小和发布日期都没有显示与CAR的重大关联. (4) 不检索,允许对相同权重进行思考,13个模型中的8个模型的CAR(平均减少14%)就会大大降低,反应从公认的不确定性转变为前提否定。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
A player fleeing skeletons in Minecraft Java Edition asks an assistant whether copper horse armor would let a horse survive three arrows.
Answering requires combining the rules for arrow damage, horse health points, and the protection supplied by this particular armor in a specific game edition.
Suppose copper horse armor was introduced after both the model’s training and its retrieval corpus.
Passages about horses, skeletons and other armor types may be relevant, yet the key fact about the horse’s armor is missing.
The assistant must acknowledge this knowledge gap.
For instance, when asked for the armor’s protection, Qwen3 32B with thinking enabled instead declares: “Since ‘copper horse armor’ is not a recognized item in the game, it would provide 0 armor points. If you meant golden horse armor, it provides 7 armor points.” ( Table 1 ). This response treats a presupposition it cannot verify as false ( Kim et al., 2021 ; Kim et al., 2023 ) , a premise denial , then substitutes a different item for the one the user asked about.
blocks.zh:
一名玩家在"Minecraft Java Edition"中逃离了骨架,他询问一名助手铜马装甲是否会让一匹马活过三箭.
答题需要将"箭伤","马健康分"等规则,以及这种特殊装甲在特定游戏版中提供的保护结合起来.
如果铜马盔甲是经过模型的训练及其取回器后推出的。
有关马、骨架和其他装甲类型的传道可能与此相关,然而,关于马的装甲的关键事实却缺失了。
助理必须承认这一知识差距。
例如,当要求装甲保护时,有思维能力的Quen3 32B宣布: " 由于`铜马盔甲'不是游戏中公认的物品,它将提供0个装甲分. 如果你指的是金马盔甲,它提供了7个装甲分". (表1) (单位:千美元) 此回应将预想视为其无法验证为虚假(Kim等,2021;Kim等,2023),前提否定后取而代之,取而代之的是用户所询问的内容.

blocks.en:
For RAG systems, recognizing such a knowledge gap must remain part of the decision to answer as retrieval and thinking proceed.
This matters most when the answers are consumed by AI agents, which may not notice that a premise denial is unsupported by the model’s available knowledge.
A human user, by contrast, may know that a new law was just passed, or that copper horse armor was added to Minecraft , when posing their query.
Evaluation must therefore distinguish an admission of missing knowledge from a premise denial that the model cannot verify.
blocks.zh:
对于RAG系统来说,承认这种知识差距必须仍然是在检索和思考过程中作出回答的决定的一部分。
这在回答被人工智能代理人所消耗时最为重要,人工智能代理人可能不会注意到一个前提的否定得不到该模型现有知识的支持。
人类使用者可能知道新法刚刚被通过,
因此,评价必须区分承认缺失知识与否认模型无法核实的前提。

blocks.en:
Distinguishing abstention from premise denial matters for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) wherever documentation and the world it describes can change ( Barnett et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2024 ) .
RAG systems can combine retrieved documents with parametric knowledge , the information stored in a model’s weights ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) .
Unless explicitly asked about a historical version, a system should allow for questions about a time after both the corpus cut-off and the model’s knowledge cut-off.
An item absent from an earlier version may exist when the user asks about it; absence from the available sources does not establish present-day nonexistence.
A reliable system should therefore abstain when these sources together cannot support an answer, identifying the knowledge gap, without categorically rejecting a premise it cannot verify.
blocks.zh:
在文件及其描述的世界可以改变的地方,与拒绝检索的前提事项区别开来(RAG)(Barnet等,2024;徐等,2024)。
RAG系统可以将检索到的文档与参数化知识相结合,即存储在模型重量中的信息(Lewis等,2020年).
除非明确询问历史版本,否则,一个系统应该允许在程序终止和模型的知识终止之后大约一段时间内提出问题。
当用户问及之前版本中缺失的项目时,可能会存在;没有可用的来源并不能证明今天不存在.
因此,如果这些来源不能共同支持答案,找出知识差距,而明确拒绝其无法核实的前提,一个可靠的系统就应弃权。

blocks.en:
Evaluating this behavior is challenging: an answer missing from retrieved passages may still be available in the model’s weights.
Context-grounded benchmarks instruct models to answer only from supplied documents ( Song et al., 2025 ; Ming et al., 2025 ; Muhamed et al., 2026 ) .
UAEval4RAG’s out-of-database questions include facts from newer news absent from its database, under a database-grounded answering protocol ( Peng et al., 2025 ) .
AbstentionBench evaluates, without retrieval, questions whose answers changed after the models’ knowledge cut-offs ( Kirichenko et al., 2025 ) .
Our study combines a time-partitioned corpus, whose later part postdates the models’ knowledge cut-offs, with related but insufficient retrieved evidence, and scores premise denial separately from acknowledged uncertainty.

blocks.en:
To evaluate this setting, we introduce DeclineCraft , a dynamic benchmark of 700 answerable and 300 unanswerable questions built from the update history of Minecraft ( Minecraft Wiki Contributors, 2026 ) .
The interacting game mechanics of Minecraft and its feature additions over time create facts that can only be learned from new wiki pages: e.g., knowing how existing armor works does not establish the protection of a newly introduced material against a pre-existing weapon.
We construct a retrieval corpus ( C pre C_{\text{pre}} ) from wiki pages as they stood at a corpus cut-off and generate unanswerable questions from pages created later ( C post C_{\text{post}} ).
Answerable questions use the same generation pipeline as unanswerable ones, with their target facts drawn from the earlier corpus ( Figure 1 ).
We audit our unanswerable questions against the earlier documentation. To assess possible parametric exposure, we use published knowledge cut-offs and a leakage audit . The leakage audit tests whether models answer the unanswerable questions correctly without retrieval.
The temporal design establishes a knowledge gap when the required facts postdate both parametric knowledge and the RAG corpus.
The benchmark is dynamic: it can be regenerated with a later corpus cut-off as new game content becomes available.

blocks.en:
We evaluate 27 LLMs from several families under three retrieval conditions, with thinking enabled and disabled where possible. Single-shot RAG retrieves five wiki passages ( chunks ) once, combining keyword and embedding search. Iterative RAG lets the model request up to two further retrieval rounds when it judges the chunks insufficient ( Section 4.2 ).
We measure Correct Abstention Rate (CAR) as the share of unanswerable questions on which a model acknowledges that it lacks the answer.
Our experiments yield three main findings: • Retrieval helps models recognize missing knowledge, but additions to the retrieval pipeline erode that benefit. Single-shot RAG raises CAR for almost every configuration.
Iterative RAG, ten instead of five chunks per query, and query rewriting with reranking each lower it again ( Section 4.2 ). • Newer and larger models do not reliably acknowledge knowledge gaps. CAR has no significant association with release date or parameter count.
Recent families such as Qwen3.5 and Qwen3-Next often deny the existence of the item or feature mentioned in the question ( Section 4.3 ). • Thinking can replace uncertainty with premise denial. Without retrieval, enabling thinking significantly lowers CAR for 8 of the 13 models with switchable thinking and raises it for none.
The lost abstentions most often become premise denials.
With retrieval, the effect of thinking differs by model ( Section 4.4 ).

我们的实验得出了三个主要结论: 检索有助于模型识别缺失的知识,但检索管道的添加会侵蚀这一好处。 单发RAG为几乎所有配置提升了CAR.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
SQuAD 2.0 evaluates abstention when a passage lacks the answer ( Rajpurkar et al., 2018 ) .
Selective QA studies when to withhold answers to control error among answered questions ( Kamath et al., 2020 ) .
R-Tuning trains models to acknowledge gaps in parametric knowledge ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , while Feng et al. (2024) use collaboration between models to detect knowledge gaps and decide whether to abstain.

blocks.en:
AbstentionBench includes stale-knowledge questions evaluated without retrieval ( Kirichenko et al., 2025 ) .
RefusalBench perturbs question–passage pairs to test context-grounded abstention ( Muhamed et al., 2026 ) .
On DeclineCraft , its context-only answer prompt makes models decline many answerable questions (Appendix B ).
Among its six categories, UAEval4RAG generates out-of-database questions from recent news and evaluates abstention when the database lacks support ( Peng et al., 2025 ) .
Our setting permits both retrieved and parametric knowledge and distinguishes acknowledged uncertainty from premise denial, following (QA) 2 ’s distinction between false and unverifiable assumptions ( Kim et al., 2023 ) .

blocks.en:
Mallen et al. (2023) show that retrieval helps answer questions about less popular facts that models struggle to recall. Joren et al. (2025) study whether the retrieved context alone suffices to answer, and how models behave when it does not.

blocks.en: 3 DeclineCraft : A Dynamic Benchmark for Knowledge-Aware Abstention
blocks.zh: 3 下降:知识-知识留置的动态基准

blocks.en:
DeclineCraft evaluates whether a RAG system recognizes when its parametric knowledge and retrieved documents together cannot support an answer.
The questions use real Minecraft content, including additions documented after the corpus cut-off.
When the required facts also postdate the model’s knowledge cut-off, the system should acknowledge the missing information.
We distinguish such a response from premise denial, in which the model asserts, without support, that an item or feature named in the question does not exist.
The issue is whether the model has enough knowledge to justify that claim, even if it happens to be correct. Table 1 shows an example of each, alongside a third outcome: an unsupported answer.

这些问题使用了真实的Minecraft内容,包括被禁用后记录的添加.
如果所要求的事实也发生在模型的知识截止之后,系统就应承认缺失的信息。
我们把这种答复与否定前提区分开来,在否定前提中,模型在没有支持的情况下声称,问题中提到的物品或特征并不存在。
问题在于该模型是否有足够的知识来证明这一主张是合理的,即使它恰好是正确的。 表1列出了每个例子,以及第三个结果:一个没有支持的答案。

Figure 1 traces the generation of one answerable question (top, blue) and one unanswerable question (bottom, orange) through the same five steps.
A generator LLM, Qwen3.5 122B-A10B , performs every writing step, each with its own prompt (Appendix J.1 ). 1. Scenario. We draw three random chunks from C pre C_{\text{pre}} and give them to the generator. It writes a player scenario of under 30 words about one or two related concepts in these chunks. 2. Target chunk. For an answerable question, we embed the scenario with Qwen3-Embedding-8B and retrieve the ten chunks with the most similar embeddings in terms of cosine similarity from C pre C_{\text{pre}} . For an unanswerable question, we follow the same procedure, except the chunks are retrieved from C post C_{\text{post}} . We drop chunks from technical pages and, for an answerable question, the scenario’s own three chunks. The target chunk is drawn uniformly at random from the five highest-ranked chunks that remain. 3. Fact. The generator lists up to six facts that appear in the target chunk but not in the comparison text. For an answerable question, the comparison text is the scenario’s three chunks, so the scenario does not already contain the fact. For an unanswerable question, it is the three C pre C_{\text{pre}} chunks most similar to the target chunk, so the fact is new relative to C pre C_{\text{pre}} . One listed fact is chosen uniformly at random. 4. Question. The generator receives the scenario, the fact and the target chunk. It writes one candidate question from the player’s perspective whose answer is the fact, and the question is appended to the scenario. 5. Verification. A separate LLM checks each candidate against C pre C_{\text{pre}} ( Section 3.3 ). Appendix G compares Qwen3.5 122B-A10B with two other generators on the same pipeline; we chose to use Qwen3.5 122B-A10B since the resulting answerable and unanswerable questions were the hardest to tell apart by wording alone.
Appendix F details the algorithms, and Appendix C shows a generated question of each kind.

blocks.en:
A separate verifier LLM, Gemma 4 31B , checks each candidate scenario and question, so that no model judges its own questions.
For each query, the verifier reads the 10 C pre C_{\text{pre}} chunks retrieved with hybrid retrieval and reranking. Reranking uses a second model to reorder the retrieved chunks by their relevance to the query.
An answerable candidate is kept only if both of the following hold: (1) the scenario does not state or directly imply the target fact, so it does not give the answer away; and (2) the chunks retrieved for the question contain the information needed to answer it.
An unanswerable candidate is kept only if both of the following hold: (1) the C pre C_{\text{pre}} chunks retrieved for the target fact do not state or directly imply it; and (2) the chunks retrieved for the question do not answer it.
Appendix J gives the verifier’s prompts.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: In what follows, we introduce our results over 27 LLMs evaluated on DeclineCraft without retrieval, with single-shot RAG and with iterative RAG. We assess whether models acknowledge missing knowledge on unanswerable questions while attempting and correctly answering answerable questions. After describing the evaluation setup and metrics ( Section 4.1 ), we compare retrieval conditions ( Section 4.2 ), examine the associations of Correct Abstention Rate with model size and release date ( Section 4.3 ), and measure the effect of enabling thinking ( Section 4.4 ). Throughout these results, we distinguish acknowledged uncertainty from premise denial. Appendix A reports the results for every model and further analyses.
blocks.zh: 在下文中,我们介绍在不进行检索的情况下评价的27个LLMs的结果,这些结果包括单发RAG和迭代RAG。 我们评估模型是否承认对无法回答的问题缺乏知识,同时试图并正确回答可回答的问题。 在描述评价的设置和衡量标准(第4.1节)之后,我们比较检索条件(第4.2节),审查正确留置率与模型大小和发布日期的关系(第4.3节),并衡量使能思维的效果(第4.4节)。 在所有这些结果中,我们区分了公认的不确定性和否定前提。 附 录 一份报告每个模型的结果和进一步的分析。

blocks.en: We use the 700 answerable and 300 unanswerable questions constructed in Section 3 . A configuration is one model with one thinking setting. 13 models have switchable thinking (the same weights run with thinking enabled or disabled); running both gives 40 configurations per retrieval condition. Appendix H gives the API settings and statistical tests; Appendix K lists the models and their knowledge cut-offs, and Tables 2 and 3 report every model and thinking setting under each condition.

blocks.en: Correct Abstention Rate (CAR) is the percentage of unanswerable questions on which the model acknowledges insufficient knowledge without a premise denial or an unsupported answer. An LLM response judge labels each response as an abstention, a premise denial or an attempted answer (Appendix I ). A premise denial followed by a guessed answer still counts as a premise denial, not a correct abstention. Premise denials of answerable questions count as attempts. Appendix I repeats the analyses under a lenient rule that also counts premise denials as abstentions: the retrieval findings hold, whereas the thinking and release-date findings change. Answerable Attempt Rate is the percentage of answerable questions the model attempts to answer. Answer Accuracy averages the scores of three LLM accuracy judges from different families on the answerable questions: 1 for correct, 0.5 for partly correct and 0 for incorrect answers or abstentions, against reference answers that an oracle model writes from each question’s source pages. Outputs that exhaust the output budget of 16,000 tokens, including thinking, without a final answer (1.9% of all answers; Appendix H ) are excluded from the two rates and score 0 in Answer Accuracy. Appendix I details the scoring.

blocks.en: 4.2 Retrieval Raises Correct Abstention Rate; Iterative RAG Lowers It Again

blocks.en: Single-shot RAG retrieves five chunks from C pre C_{\text{pre}} using the default hybrid retriever (BM25 and dense retrieval, combined by reciprocal rank fusion; see details in Appendix E ). Figure 2 plots Correct Abstention Rate (y-axis) against the retrieval condition (x-axis) for the subset of 11 models also evaluated with ten retrieved chunks; gray lines show individual models, and the blue line shows their mean. Across all 40 configurations, mean Correct Abstention Rate rises from 17.1% without retrieval to 56.4% with single-shot RAG. Relative to no retrieval, 38 configurations show a statistically significant increase in Correct Abstention Rate, and none shows a statistically significant decrease ( q < 0.05 q<0.05 ; see Appendix H for details on statistical analysis).
blocks.zh: 单发RAG使用默认的混合检索器从C前取取出5个块(BM25和密集取回,由对等的等分聚;见附录E中的细节). 图2 图2 对11个模型的子集进行检索条件(x轴)的正确留置率(y-轴);灰色线条显示单个模型,而蓝线显示其平均值。 在所有40个配置中,平均正确留置率从17.1%的无取回率上升至56.4%的单发RAG. 相对于没有检索,38个配置显示在统计学上正确的留置率有显著上升,没有任何一个显示在统计学上显著下降(q < 0.05 q < 0.05;关于统计分析的细节见附录H)。

blocks.en: Our iterative RAG implementation uses prompted self-assessment, inspired by Self-RAG ( Asai et al., 2024 ) and query-level self-evaluation ( Xie et al., 2026 ) . In our experiments, it starts with the same five chunks and lets the model request up to two additional retrieval rounds when it judges the context insufficient (Algorithm 4 ; Appendix H ). Relative to single-shot RAG, mean Correct Abstention Rate falls to 46.4%, with significant decreases in 30 of the same 40 configurations and no significant increases. Mean Answer Accuracy on the answerable questions changes from 68.5% to 69.3%, compared with 24.3% without retrieval. Figure 8 in the appendix shows both metrics for each configuration. Thus, in this pipeline, further retrieval lowers CAR while adding little accuracy.
blocks.zh: 我们反复使用RAG, 促使自评(Asai等人, 2024年)和查询级自评(Xie等人, 2026年)。 在我们的实验中,它从同样的5个块开始,当模型判断上下文不充分时,让模型请求最多增加两个检索回合(算法4;附录H)。 相对于单发RAG,指正确留学率降至46.4%,同为40个配置中的30个显著下降而无显著增长. 平均回答 可回答问题的准确度从68.5%到69.3%,而24.3%没有检索。 附录中的图8显示了每种配置的两种度量标准。 因此,在这一管道中,进一步的取回降低了CAR,但增加了很少的准确性。

blocks.en: The Sulfur Cube example in Appendix A.9 illustrates this failure: GPT-OSS 120B correctly abstains with single-shot RAG, then uses a retrieved passage about Magma Cubes to answer about the unfamiliar entity after further retrieval. The example shows how relevant-looking context can support an unwarranted substitution; the aggregate comparison does not isolate which component of iterative RAG causes the decrease, and the reflection prompt itself asks whether the context suffices to answer rather than whether to answer at all.

blocks.en: 4.3 Correct Abstention Rate Has No Significant Association with Size or Release Date
blocks.zh: 4.3 正确录取率与大小或释放日期没有重大关联

blocks.en: Under single-shot RAG, neither total parameters (Spearman ρ = − 0.24 \rho=-0.24 , p = 0.31 p=0.31 ) nor active parameters ( ρ = + 0.21 \rho=+0.21 , p = 0.37 p=0.37 ) has a significant association with Correct Abstention Rate across the 20 open-weight models. Active parameters are those used for each token. A mixture-of-experts model uses only part of its total parameters for each token. Figure 5 (left) shows the comparison with total parameters, with thinking enabled where switchable; Figure 12 in the appendix shows active parameters. Release month likewise has no significant association across all 27 models ( ρ = − 0.16 \rho=-0.16 , p = 0.42 p=0.42 ; Figure 5 , right), or across the 14 families when selecting the model with the highest Correct Abstention Rate in each ( ρ = − 0.22 \rho=-0.22 , p = 0.45 p=0.45 ). On the same open-weight models, Answer Accuracy is positively associated with total parameters ( ρ = + 0.60 \rho=+0.60 , p = 0.005 p=0.005 ; Figure 13 in the appendix). Thus, the observed accuracy gains with scale do not establish better recognition of missing knowledge.

blocks.en: The response categories matter for interpreting this result. Recent families such as Qwen3.5 and Qwen3-Next frequently respond with premise denial: they assert, without support, that the queried item does not exist. Figures 17 and 18 in the appendix separate premise denials from abstentions and attempted answers, by family and model. As the copper horse armor responses in Table 1 illustrate, a premise denial can also lead to a numerical answer or the substitution of a familiar item. Such a response does not establish recognition of a knowledge gap, even if its claim was true at the corpus cut-off.
blocks.zh: 答复类别对这一结果的解释很重要。 最近的一些家庭,如Qune3.5和Qune3-Next,经常以前提否认的方式作出答复:他们声称,在没有支持的情况下,被询问的项目不存在。 附录中的图17和图18按家庭和模式分别列出了拒绝弃权和试图答复的前提。 如表1中的铜马盔甲反应所说明,一个前提否定也可以导致一个数字答案或者替换一个熟悉的项目. 这种答复没有确认知识差距,即使其主张在终止诉讼时是真实的。

blocks.en: 4.4 Thinking Lowers Correct Abstention Rate Without Retrieval
blocks.zh: 4.4 在不收回的情况下考虑降低录取率

blocks.en: Figure 4 compares thinking disabled (gray dots) and enabled (arrowheads) for the 13 models with switchable thinking, holding weights fixed, without retrieval (left) and with single-shot RAG (right). Orange indicates lower CAR, blue higher; faded arrows mark changes that are not statistically significant.

blocks.en: Without retrieval, we observe 8 statistically significant decreases in CAR and no statistically significant increases. Per question, enabling thinking without retrieval turns abstentions into premise denials more often than the reverse for 9 models ( Figure 25 ). Appendix A.5 shows that Answer Accuracy can improve while CAR falls.
blocks.zh: 没有检索,我们看到中非共和国有8个统计数字显著减少,没有统计数字显著增加。 按问题来看,允许不进行检索的思考,比9个模型的相反情况更经常地成为否定前提(图25)。 附录A.5显示,在中非共和国崩溃时,回答准确性可以提高。

blocks.en: Across 40 single-shot RAG configurations, Answer Accuracy and CAR have no statistically significant unadjusted association (Spearman ρ = − 0.28 \rho=-0.28 , p = 0.08 p=0.08 ); Appendix A.6 reports a negative association after adjusting for release date.
blocks.zh: 在40个单一镜头的RAG配置中,Answer Accurity和CAR没有统计学上显著的未经调整的关联(Spearman ^ = − 0.28\rho=-0.28,p = 0.08 p = 0.08);附录A.6报告在调整发布日期后存在负面关联。

blocks.en: With single-shot RAG, 33 of 40 configurations have both a higher CAR and a higher Answerable Attempt Rate than without retrieval (Appendix A.7 ).
blocks.zh: 通过单发RAG,40个配置中有33个的CAR和可答尝试率都高于无取回率(附录A.7).

blocks.en: 4.5 Models Fine-Tuned to Abstain
blocks.zh: 4.5 模型精细到沉淀

blocks.en: Some models are fine-tuned specifically for abstention, such as Trust-Align 3B , Trust-Align 7B ( Song et al., 2025 ) , and Abstain-R1 3B ( Zhai et al., 2026 ) . We evaluate these three models against their corresponding base model (Appendix A.8 ). Figure 7 shows that fine-tuning raises CAR and lowers Answerable Attempt Rate. With single-shot RAG, fine-tuning raises CAR from 35.7% ( Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct ) to 89.3% ( Trust-Align 3B ), but Trust-Align 3B attempts only 43.6% of answerable questions. These models lie on or near the Pareto trade-off frontier of the other configurations, the highest CAR that they reach at or above each Answerable Attempt Rate. They trade a higher CAR for lower Answerable Attempt Rate and Answer Accuracy by abstaining on answerable questions that other models answer correctly ( Figure 7 ). Fine-tuning moves these three models along the trade-off frontier rather than beyond it.
blocks.zh: 一些型号对弃权进行了特别的微调,如Trust-Align 3B,Trust-Align 7B(Song等,2025年)和Abstain-R1 3B(Zhai等,2026年)等. 我们对照它们相应的基准模型(附录A.8)来评价这三个模型. 图7显示,微调提高了CAR,降低了可回答尝试率。 通过单发RAG,微调将CAR从35.7%(Quen2.5-3B-Instruct )提升到89.3%(Trust-Align 3B),但Trust-Align 3B只尝试了43.6%的可回答问题. 这些模型位于或靠近其他配置的Pareto取舍边界,是它们达到或高于每个可回答尝试率的最高CAR。 通过弃权处理其他模型正确回答的可回答问题,它们以较高的CAR换取较低的可回答尝试率和答案准确度(图7)。 精细调整后将这三种模型沿取舍边界移动而不是超越.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced DeclineCraft , a dynamic benchmark built from dated Minecraft Wiki pages to evaluate recognition of missing knowledge and distinguish acknowledged uncertainty from premise denial. Across 27 LLMs, single-shot RAG produces statistically significant increases in Correct Abstention Rate in 38 of 40 configurations relative to no retrieval; our prompted iterative RAG pipeline produces statistically significant decreases in 30 of the same configurations relative to single-shot RAG, with little change in Answer Accuracy. Under single-shot RAG, Correct Abstention Rate has no statistically significant association with model size or release date. Enabling thinking produces statistically significant decreases in Correct Abstention Rate for 8 of 13 models without retrieval, with no statistically significant increases; its effect with single-shot RAG varies across models.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了DevelopeCraft,这是一个动态的基准,它建立在日期已久的Minecraft Wiki网页上,用来评价对缺失知识的识别,并区分公认的不确定性与前提否定. 在27个LLMs中,单发RAG在统计学上显著提高了40个配置中38个的正确留置率,而不是检索;我们推动的迭接RAG管道在统计上显著降低了30个相同的配置,而单发RAG则没有变化。 在单发RAG下,正确的留置率与模型大小或发布日期没有统计意义联系. 使能思维在统计学上显著降低13个模型中8个没有检索的正确留置率,在统计学上没有显著增加;它对单发RAG的影响因模型而异.

blocks.en: These results motivate evaluating and training recognition of missing knowledge explicitly. A premise denial does not establish this recognition when the model cannot verify its claim. Future work should improve judgments of evidence sufficiency across retrieval rounds and test whether these findings extend to other domains with dated documentation.
blocks.zh: 这些结果促使人们明确评价和培训对缺乏知识的认识。 在模型无法核实其主张时,前提否定不能证明这种承认。 今后的工作应改进对证据充分性的判断,并检验这些结论是否扩大到其他有过时文件的领域。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 限制

blocks.en: While DeclineCraft provides a controlled environment to evaluate the temporal adaptability and abstention capabilities of RAG-equipped LLMs, we identify several limitations to our work.
blocks.zh: 虽然RecordeCraft提供了一种可控制的环境,用以评价装备有RAG的LLMs的时间适应性和弃权能力,但我们找出了我们工作的几个局限性。

blocks.en: 6.1 Domain Concentration of the Corpus
blocks.zh: 6.1 公司域浓度

blocks.en: Our framework uses only the Minecraft Wiki, which may not represent the complexity of other domains where RAG systems are deployed. Other domains may have more erroneous chunks or poorly maintained version histories, or may not receive regular updates. Future work is needed to test whether our findings on knowledge unavailability at a corpus cut-off generalize to other domains.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架只使用Minecraft Wiki,它可能不代表部署RAG系统的其他域的复杂性. 其他域可能有更错误的块或维护不良的版本历史,或可能得不到定期更新. 今后需要进行工作,以检验我们关于断断续续地获取知识的调查结果是否将知识归纳到其他领域。

blocks.en: 6.2 Dependence on LLM Judges
blocks.zh: 6.2 对LLM法官的依赖

blocks.en: We rely on LLMs throughout: Qwen3.5 122B-A10B writes the questions, Gemma 4 31B verifies them, the response judge Gemma 4 26B-A4B labels abstentions and premise denials, the oracle model DeepSeek V4.1 Flash writes reference answers, and three accuracy judges score the answers. These models may impart their own biases, such as preferring longer answers or asking underspecified questions. A human study on 100 shared items ( Appendix I ) finds that the judges agree with the annotators at least as well as the annotators agree with one another, but it covers a small sample. The two accuracy judges whose families we also evaluate show a small self-preference ( Section A.1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们全靠LLMs: Quen3.5 122B-A10B写出问题,Gemma 4 31B验证它们,应答法官Gemma 4 26B-A4B标签弃权及前提否定,甲骨文模型DeepSeek V4.1 Flash写出参考答案,三位精准判断者评出答案. 这些模式可能带来自己的偏见,例如更偏爱较长的答案或提出不明确的问题。 关于100个共享项目的一项人类研究(附录一)发现,法官们至少同意注释者的意见,而注释者则彼此同意,但该研究涉及一个小样本。 两位准确的法官,我们评价他们的家庭,显示他们有一点自我偏爱(A.1节)。

blocks.en: 6.3 One Chunking Scheme and Embedding Model
blocks.zh: 6.3 一个春金方案和嵌入模型

blocks.en: We compare six retrieval pipelines, including reranking and query rewriting, but all of them search the same index: fixed-size chunks of about 1,500 characters split at line breaks, embedded with Qwen3-Embedding-8B . Hierarchical or semantic chunking, or other embedding models, may retrieve differently.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了6个检索管道,包括重排和查询重写,但是它们都搜索相同的索引:固定大小的块,大约1500个字符在行间断开,嵌入了Qune3-Embedding-8B. 分层或语义分块,或其他嵌入模型,可能会以不同的方式取回.

blocks.en: 6.4 Scoring Premise Denials
blocks.zh: 6.4 分红

blocks.en: Our headline Correct Abstention Rate excludes premise denials, including premise denials followed by a guessed answer. We report these responses separately from acknowledged uncertainty (Appendix I ). The answer prompt did not tell models that the game may contain items newer than their knowledge. We have not tested whether making this temporal uncertainty explicit changes the frequency of premise denials.
blocks.zh: 我们的标题"正确留置率"排除了前提的否定,包括前提的否定,然后是猜测的答案. 我们将这些答复与承认的不确定性分开报告(附录一)。 答案提示没有告诉模型游戏可能包含比他们所知的更新的项目. 我们没有测试这种时间不确定性是否明确改变拒绝前提的频率。

blocks.en: 6.5 Limited Evaluation Models
blocks.zh: 6.5 有限评价模式

blocks.en: Because of cloud inference costs and limited local hardware, we selected models to cover a wide range of sizes, architectures and families. We chose the Qwen3 family because it offers many sizes and architectures within one family, which lets us vary one factor while holding the others fixed.
blocks.zh: 由于云推论成本和有限的本地硬件,我们选择了模型来涵盖广泛的大小,建筑和家庭. 我们选择了Qwen3家族,因为它在一个家族中提供了许多大小和建筑,这让我们在固定其他家族的同时改变一个因素.

blocks.en: A.1 Do Accuracy Judges Have a Self-Preference?
blocks.zh: A.1 准确法官是否享有自我偏爱?

blocks.en: Two of the three accuracy judges come from model families we also evaluate: Gemma 4 31B (Gemma) and Qwen3.8 27B (Qwen). A judge with a self-preference would score answers from its own family higher than the other judges do. For each of these two judges, we take the difference between its score and the mean score of the other two judges on the same answer. Its self-preference is the mean difference on answers from models of its own family minus the mean difference on answers from all other models, with a 95% bootstrap interval over questions.
blocks.zh: 三位精准评委中有两位来自我们评价的模范家族:Gemma 4 31B (Gemma)和Quen3.8 27B (Quen). 具有自我偏爱的法官会比其他法官更了解自己家庭的答案。 对于这两位评委中的每一位,我们都要从它的得分与其他两位评委在同一个答案上的平均得分之间取出相差. 它的自我偏好是自己家庭的模型对答案的平均值差异减去所有其他模型对答案的平均值差异,比起提问,其比起95%的靴子间隔.

blocks.en: Both judges show a small self-preference: +1.0% points for Gemma 4 31B (+0.5 to +1.4) and +1.8% points for Qwen3.8 27B (+1.4 to +2.2). Both are small next to the judges’ differences in leniency, a judge’s tendency to score every answer higher or lower than the other judges do, whatever model wrote it. Against the mean of the three judges, Gemma 4 31B scores +3.0, Laguna S 2.1 +4.9 and Qwen3.8 27B -7.9% points. Because Answer Accuracy averages the three judges, a self-preference enters it at about a third of its size.
blocks.zh: 两位评委都表现出了小的自首:Gemma 4 31B(+0.5至+1.4)的分数为+1.0%;Qune3.8 27B(+1.4至+2.2)的分数为+1.8%. 两者都与法官在宽大处理方面的差异相去甚远,法官往往比其他法官的回答都高或低,无论模式如何。 相较于三位裁判的中分,Gemma 4 31B得分+3.0分,Laguna S 2.1 + 4.9分和Qune3.8分27B-7.9%分. 由于回答准确度平均为三位裁判,因此自取其分量的三分之一左右进入.

blocks.en: As a further check, we recompute each configuration’s Answer Accuracy using only the accuracy judges from other families. The ranking of the 40 configurations with single-shot RAG then has a Spearman correlation of 0.84 with the original ranking. The change comes mostly from leniency rather than self-preference. Dropping Qwen3.8 27B , the least lenient judge, changes the accuracy of Qwen3, Qwen3-Next and Qwen3.5 models by +3.5, +3.0 and +3.6% points on average, and dropping Gemma 4 31B , which scores above the mean, changes Gemma 3 and Gemma 4 models by -1.2 and -2.1% points.
blocks.zh: 作为进一步检查,我们只利用其他家庭的准确性判断来重新计算每个组合的答案准确性。 而后以单发RAG的40个配置的排名,斯皮尔曼的相关排名为0.84,与原来的排名相呼应. 变化主要来自宽大而非自我偏爱。 Dropping Qune3.8 27B,最不宽容的裁判,将Qune3,Qune3-Next和Qune3.5模型的精度由+3.5,+3.0和+3.6%的平均分数来改变,将Gemma 4 31B,其分数高于平均值,以-1.2和-2.1%的分数来改变Gemma 3和Gemma 4模型.

blocks.en: A.2 Ablation: Increasing Retrieval Depth Lowers Correct Abstention Rate
blocks.zh: A.2 校正: 提高检索深度

blocks.en: To compare a larger single retrieval with iterative RAG, we evaluate the 11 models with single-shot runs at both k = 5 k{=}5 and k = 10 k{=}10 ( Figure 2 ). We disable thinking where switchable and use the other models’ defaults. On this subset, mean Correct Abstention Rate is 12.2% without retrieval, 56.8% at k = 5 k{=}5 , 51.7% at k = 10 k{=}10 and 44.9% with iterative RAG. Iterative RAG yields a lower Correct Abstention Rate than single-shot RAG at k = 5 k{=}5 for all 11 models. Doubling k k also lowers the mean, so the results do not support attributing the iterative decrease solely to follow-up query selection: chunk count and context length change together, and iterative RAG additionally changes the queries and introduces self-reflection.

blocks.en: A.3 Ablation: Query Rewriting and Reranking Lower Correct Abstention Rate
blocks.zh: A.3 校正率: 查询重写和重新排序

blocks.en: We compare six pipelines under single-shot RAG with five retrieved chunks, holding the evaluated models and their thinking settings fixed. Appendix E specifies the retrievers, query rewrites and reranker. For the 12 models in Figure 3 , mean Correct Abstention Rate is 59.4% with BM25, 52.2% with dense retrieval, 54.7% with the default hybrid retriever, 52.5% with hybrid plus reranking, 52.5% with hybrid plus query rewriting and 49.8% with both additions. The combined pipeline yields a lower Correct Abstention Rate than the default hybrid retriever for all 12 models. These results concern the tested implementations; pipeline complexity does not establish that one retriever supplies better evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们把6个管道与5个回收块进行单发RAG的比较,将评估模型及其思维设置固定下来。 附 录 E指定了检索器,查询重写和重排. 对于图3中的12个模型,BM25的平均正确留置率是59.4%,高密度检索率为52.2%,默认混合取取回器为54.7%,混合加重排为52.5%,混合加查询重写为52.5%,两者均增加了49.8%. 混合管的正确留置率低于所有12个型号的默认混合取取器。 这些结果涉及经测试的实施;管道的复杂性不能证明一个回收商提供了更好的证据。

blocks.en: Each question opens with a player scenario written from C pre C_{\text{pre}} pages ( Section 3.2 ). To test whether it matters, we reran 10 models without it: the question alone serves as both the retrieval query and the model’s input. Without the scenario, Correct Abstention Rate rises from 50.9% to 57.4%, for all 10 models, while Answerable Attempt Rate is almost unchanged ( Figure 23 ). A benchmark of bare questions would therefore overstate how often models abstain. With hybrid retrieval, 71.3% of unanswerable questions also retrieve a passage the scenario was written from ( Figure 24 ).

blocks.en: Each of the 13 models with switchable thinking answered every unanswerable question twice with the same weights, thinking disabled and enabled. Each answer carries the response judge’s label (abstain, deny, answer). For each model and retrieval condition we cross-tabulate the two labels of each question, leaving out questions where either answer exhausted the token budget. The two discordant cells abstain → \to deny (A → \to D) and deny → \to abstain (D → \to A) are compared with an exact McNemar test: if thinking moved answers between the two labels equally often in both directions, A → \to D would follow a binomial distribution with n n = A → \to D + D → \to A trials and probability 1 2 \frac{1}{2} . The same test compares abstain → \to answer with answer → \to abstain (A → \to X, X → \to A), so that a loss of abstention through guessing is not counted as premise denial. Table 8 and Figure 25 report the results, with significance assessed as in Appendix H .

blocks.en: Without retrieval, thinking turns 372 abstentions into premise denials and 51 premise denials into abstentions (3,404 matched questions). The excess of A → \to D is significant for 9 of the 13 models, and no model shows a significant shift the other way; across models, the per-model net shift (A → \to D − - D → \to A, as a share of questions) averages + 8.6 +8.6 points (Wilcoxon signed-rank, p = 0.001 p=0.001 ). Of the abstentions lost to thinking, 54.6% became premise denials and the rest attempted answers; the A → \to X excess is significant for 5 models. The Qwen3.5 models rarely abstain without retrieval in either mode, so they contribute few pairs. With single-shot RAG the shift towards premise denial remains (315 against 133; significant for 6 models, the reverse for 1), but for 5 models, mostly Qwen3, thinking also turns attempted answers into abstentions, which is why its net effect on Correct Abstention Rate with retrieval is mixed.

Quen3.5模型很少在两种模式中不进行检索而弃用,因此它们贡献了很少一对. 单发的RAG(315对133;对6个模型来说是显著的,对1个模型来说是相反的),但对于5个模型来说,主要是Qune3,思考也把尝试的答案变成弃权,这就是为什么它对于正确取回率的净影响好坏参半。

blocks.en: Across the same 40 configurations, release month correlates with Answer Accuracy ( ρ = + 0.60 \rho=+0.60 ), but not with Correct Abstention Rate ( ρ = − 0.03 \rho=-0.03 ). Partialling out release month gives a negative association between Correct Abstention Rate and Answer Accuracy ( ρ = − 0.33 \rho=-0.33 , p = 0.04 p=0.04 ). These cross-model comparisons do not identify the accuracy cost of changing an individual model’s decision to answer: they compare different systems, and thinking configurations of the same model are not independent models. They therefore establish neither an inevitable accuracy cost nor that correct abstention is cost-free.
blocks.zh: 在相同的40个配置中,发布月与Answer精确度相关( ^ = + 0.60\rho + 0.60),但与正确留置率相关( ^ = − 0.03\rho =- 0.03) 。 部分退出发布月给出了正确退出率和回答精确度之间的负关联( ^ = 0.33\rho=-0.33, p = 0.04 p = 0.04 ) 。 这些跨模型比较无法识别改变单个模型的答案决定的准确性成本:它们比较不同的系统,而同一模型的思维配置并不是独立的模型。 因此,它们既不确定不可避免的准确性成本,也不确定正确的弃权是免费的。

blocks.en: A.7 Answerable Attempt Rate and Correct Abstention Rate
blocks.zh: A.7 可回答的尝试率和正确的留学率

blocks.en:
The trade-off frontier of a set of configurations is the highest Correct Abstention Rate observed at or above a given Answerable Attempt Rate ( Figure 28 shows the configurations). It describes the evaluated systems, rather than a trade-off obtained by varying an answer threshold within one system.
In selective QA, a risk–coverage curve instead measures error among answered questions against the fraction of all questions answered as a confidence threshold varies ( Kamath et al., 2020 ) . Our axes are rates within separate answerability classes; neither measures error among attempted answers.
blocks.zh:
一组配置的取舍边框是观察到的某一可回答尝试率或以上的最高正确留置率(图28显示了配置)。 它描述了被评价的系统,而不是通过一个系统内不同答案阈值获得的取舍。
在选择性的质量保证中,一个风险覆盖曲线对照所有回答问题中的信任阈值的一小部分来衡量所回答问题的误差(Kamath等人,2020年)。 我们的轴线是在不同的可回答类别中的比率;在试图回答时也没有衡量错误。

blocks.en: Using the 40 configurations in Table 3 , single-shot RAG yields higher Correct Abstention Rate and Answerable Attempt Rate than no retrieval in 33 configurations. In 6 configurations, Correct Abstention Rate is higher but Answerable Attempt Rate lower; the opposite holds for 1. These counts describe the directions of observed changes, not their statistical significance.

blocks.en: For an illustrative Answerable Attempt Rate requirement of at least 95%, the highest Correct Abstention Rate without retrieval is 21.0% ( Qwen3 32B , thinking disabled; Answerable Attempt Rate 95.3%). With single-shot RAG, it is 83.3% ( Gemma 4 31B , thinking disabled; Answerable Attempt Rate 95.7%). Thus, the observed trade-off frontier permits a higher Correct Abstention Rate under the same Answerable Attempt Rate requirement. The two points represent different models; they do not measure a change within one model or establish an unavoidable trade-off.
blocks.zh: 对于至少95%的可解答尝试率要求,未取回的最高正确留学率为21.0%(Quen3 32B, 思维无效;可解答尝试率95.3%)。 单发RAG为83.3%(Gemma 4 31B,思维障碍;可回答尝试率95.7%)。 因此,所观察到的取舍边界允许在相同的可回答的尝试率要求下提高正确的留学率。 这两个要点代表不同的模式;它们并不衡量一个模式内的变化,也不确立不可避免的取舍。

blocks.en: Across the 40 configurations, moving from no retrieval to single-shot RAG raises mean Answerable Attempt Rate from 90.6% to 97.3% and mean Correct Abstention Rate from 17.1% to 56.4%. Retrieval thus improves both means in this comparison. With iterative RAG, mean Answerable Attempt Rate is 97.9%, while mean Correct Abstention Rate falls to 46.4%. Figures 10 and 16 show individual configurations under single-shot and iterative RAG.
blocks.zh: 在40个配置中,从无检索到单发RAG将平均可答尝试率从90.6%提高到97.3%,并意味着正确留学率从17.1%提高到56.4%。 因此,检索在这种比较中都有所改善。 使用迭代RAG, 平均可回答尝试率为97.9%, 而平均正确留学率降至46.4%。 图10和图16显示了单发和迭代RAG下的个人配置.

blocks.en: A.8 Models Fine-Tuned to Abstain
blocks.zh: A.8 模型精细到沉淀

blocks.en: We evaluate three models fine-tuned for better abstention:
blocks.zh: 我们评价三种模式,

blocks.en: Trust-Align 3B and Trust-Align 7B ( Song et al., 2025 ) , trained with preference optimization to answer only from retrieved documents and to abstain otherwise.
blocks.zh: Trust-Align 3B和Trust-Align 7B(Song等,2025年),经过优化选择培训,只能从取回的文件中回答,否则弃权.

blocks.en: Abstain-R1 3B ( Zhai et al., 2026 ) , trained with reinforcement learning to answer “I don’t know” and state what information is missing.
blocks.zh: Abstain-R1 3B(Zhai等, 2026年),

blocks.en: Each is compared with the baseline model it was fine-tuned from, Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct or Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct . Abstain-R1 was trained with its own prompt template, so we evaluate it with that template; the other models answer with our prompt. All models answer the same 1,000 questions as the rest of the study and are labeled and scored exactly as the other models. We report single-shot RAG.
blocks.zh: 每个模型都与它从Quen2.5-3B-Instructionct 或 Quen2.5-7B-Instructionct 中微调的基线模型相提并论。 Abstain-R1是用它自己的即时模板训练的,所以我们用这个模板来评价它;其他模型用我们的即时回答. 所有模型都回答与其他研究相同的1000个问题,并被贴上标签,得分与其他模型完全一样. 我们报告单发的RAG。

blocks.en: We used the released Hugging Face checkpoints declare-lab/trustalign_qwen2.5_3b and declare-lab/trustalign_qwen2.5_7b (revisions 9ce97fa and 46f3a92 ) and leoleung04/Abstain-R1 (revision a02d6ed ), with Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct as the baseline models. All five are served with vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) with a 32,768-token context, and decode greedily at temperature 0 with the same 16,000-token output budget, retrieval and labeling as the other models. Abstain-R1 answers with its own prompt template, reproduced verbatim from Zhai et al. (2026) . Our setting differs from the one each method was trained for. Trust-Align learns to abstain whenever the retrieved documents do not state the answer, whereas our benchmark also accepts answers from the model’s own knowledge, and Abstain-R1 was trained without retrieved context. The comparison therefore measures how these methods carry over to our setting, not how well they perform on the tasks they were designed for.
blocks.zh: 我们使用已公布的Hugging Face检查站申报-lab/trustalign_qwen2.5_3b和申报-lab/trustalign_qwen2.5_7b(订正为9ce97fa和46f3a92)和leoleung04/Abstain-R1(订正为a02d6ed),以Quen/Quen2.5-3B-Instruct和Quen/Quen2.5-7B-Instruct为基准模型。 所有5个都服务于VLLM(Kwon等,2023年),上下文为32,768-token;在0温下贪婪地解码出16000-token输出预算,取回并标出与其他模型相同的标签. blocks.en: Fine-tuning moves every model up and to the left in Figure 7 : it trades Answerable Attempt Rate for Correct Abstention Rate. Fine-tuning raises CAR from 35.7% to 89.3% for Trust-Align 3B and from 57.0% to 89.7% for Trust-Align 7B , but these models attempt only 43.6% and 42.7% of answerable questions respectively, against at least 78.7% for every other configuration. With its own template, Abstain-R1 3B reaches 87.7% at an attempt rate of 73.1%, which lies on the trade-off frontier of the other configurations: Gemini 2.5 Flash matches this Correct Abstention Rate at a higher attempt rate (78.7%). Part of this shift comes from the template itself: run with the same template, the baseline model ( Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct ) reaches 75.7% at 75.9%. Trust-Align exceeds the trade-off frontier’s highest Correct Abstention Rate (87.7%) only at attempt rates no other configuration goes down to, and by less than the uncertainty of its own estimate (95% interval 85.3–92.3% for the 3B model). Fine-tuning for abstention therefore moves models along the trade-off rather than beyond it.

blocks.en: Appendix B Answering Only from the Context
blocks.zh: 附录B 答复 只从上下文

blocks.en: Context-grounded benchmarks such as RefusalBench ( Muhamed et al., 2026 ) instruct the model to answer only from the supplied context. We tested RefusalBench’s answer prompt on a sample of 243 unanswerable and 299 answerable DeclineCraft questions, each given its single top retrieved chunk, with 9 configurations of 6 open-weight models; a separate judge, an LLM that sees only the response, decides whether it declines. Under this prompt, the configurations decline 93–99% of the unanswerable questions, close to the ceiling, but they also decline 33–78% of the answerable ones. Under our prompt, which lets models use their own knowledge, they decline 5–19% of the answerable questions. The retrieved chunk is the one an answerable question was written from for only 46% of these questions, so a model that follows a context-only instruction must decline many answerable questions whatever it knows. Under such an instruction, the task reduces to deciding whether the answer is in the retrieved chunk. This is why DeclineCraft lets models use their own knowledge and counts an abstention as correct only when neither the context nor the model’s knowledge can answer the question.
blocks.zh: 以背景为基础的基准,如拒绝本克(Muhamed等人,2026年)指示该模型只从所提供的上下文中回答。 在243个无法回答和299个可回答的DrackeCraft问题样本中,我们测试了拒绝奔驰的答题提示,每个问题都给出了唯一一个顶级检索的块,有9个配置的6个开放量模型;一个单独的法官,一个只看到回答的LLM,决定它是否下降。 在这个快板下,配置下降了93-99 %的无法回答的问题,接近上限,但也下降了33-78 %的可回答问题. 在让模型使用他们自己的知识的即时反应下,它们会降低5—19 %的回答问题。 检索到的块是一个只有46%的问题可以回答的问题, 因此遵循只针对上下文的指令的模式必须拒绝许多可以回答的问题, 不管它知道什么。 根据这种指示,任务将减少决定答案是否在取回块中。 因此,DevelopeCraft让模型使用自己的知识,并且只有在上下文和模型的知识都无法回答问题时才算弃权是正确的。

blocks.en: After generation, we reviewed every unanswerable question by hand and removed 21 questions with malformed facts, such as a spin-off game (“Coral Rise”), fabricated items (“steel and fire striker”) and impossible scenarios (“creeper wielding a diamond sword”). Questions whose answer can only be guessed by analogy with an older, general mechanic (e.g. whether a new copper tool accepts an enchantment its iron counterpart accepts) were kept: assuming that an old rule carries over to a new item is the behavior the benchmark measures, and such a guess may be wrong. Each removed question was replaced by an unused candidate from the same build that had passed the same checks. The benchmark therefore keeps 700 answerable and 300 unanswerable questions, and every model answered the replacements under every condition.
blocks.zh: 世代相传后,我们用手审查了每一个无法回答的问题,并删除了21个有畸形事实的问题,如附带游戏(“Coral Rise”),捏造物品(“钢铁和打火机”)和不可能的情况(“手持一把钻石剑”)。 其答案只能与更老的普通机械师类比来猜出的问题(例如,新铜器是否接受它所接受的魔法)被保留了下来:假设旧规则接入新项目就是行为作为基准度量,这样的猜测可能是错误的. 每个被删除的问题都取而代之的是来自同一大楼的未使用候选人,他们通过了同样的检查。 因此,该基准保留了700个可回答的问题和300个不可回答的问题,每个模型在每一个条件下都回答替补.

blocks.en: • Dense. The query is embedded with Qwen3-Embedding-8B , and the k k chunks with the highest cosine similarity are returned ( Karpukhin et al., 2020 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . • BM25. Okapi BM25 over lower-cased word tokens with English stopwords removed, k 1 = 1.5 k_{1}{=}1.5 , b = 0.75 b{=}0.75 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) . It matches exact terms, such as item names, that an embedding may blur. • Hybrid (default). Dense retrieval and BM25 each return their top 20 chunks, and the two rankings are merged by reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) ( Cormack et al., 2009 ) : a chunk scores ∑ l 1 / ( 60 + r l ) \sum_{l}1/(60+r_{l}) , where r l r_{l} is its rank in list l l , and the k k highest-scoring chunks are kept. RRF uses ranks rather than raw scores, so cosine similarities and BM25 scores need no common scale, and a chunk ranked highly by both retrievers comes first. • Hybrid + rerank. The 20 highest fused chunks are rescored by a cross-encoder, llama-nemotron-rerank-1b-v2 , which reads the query and each chunk together ( Nogueira and Cho, 2019 ; NVIDIA, 2025 ) ; the k k highest are kept. • Hybrid + rewrite. An LLM ( Qwen3 30B-A3B , thinking disabled) rewrites the query into three short search queries that target the question rather than the scenario ( Ma et al., 2023 ) . The original query and the three rewrites each give a dense and a BM25 list, and all eight lists are fused by RRF. Rewrites are generated once and cached, so every model receives the same ones. • Hybrid + rerank + rewrite. Rewriting and fusion as above, then cross-encoder reranking of the 20 highest fused chunks against the original query. Follow-up queries in iterative RAG use hybrid retrieval ( Algorithm 4 ).

blocks.en: Both halves are written by the same three stages (Algorithms 1 , 2 and 3 ); the only difference is the corpus (pre- or post-cut-off) the target chunk comes from. Appendix J.1 gives the prompts, and Appendix C shows an unanswerable and an answerable example. Dense retrieval ( Qwen3-Embedding-8B ) returns the ten chunks of that corpus most similar to the scenario, excluding technical pages (engine internals, rendering and data formats) and, for answerable questions, the scenario’s own source chunks. The target chunk is drawn at random from the five highest-ranked chunks that remain. The fact chosen from this target chunk must not be stated by: the scenario’s three source chunks for answerable questions, so that the scenario does not give the answer away; and the three C pre C_{\text{pre}} chunks closest to the target for unanswerable questions, so that the fact is new relative to the pre-cut-off corpus. The generator is Qwen3.5 122B-A10B (8-bit, thinking disabled; temperature 0.3 for the scenario, 0.5 for the question, 0 otherwise). The verifier is one judge, Gemma 4 31B (8-bit, thinking disabled), which reads C pre C_{\text{pre}} through hybrid retrieval with reranking (10 chunks per query). A verdict that cannot be parsed rejects the candidate. Each stage runs over the whole benchmark at once, so each model is loaded once.

blocks.en: A question is rejected if it names its own novelty or repeats release talk from the source passage: wonder(ed/ing), suddenly, notice(d), heard, announced, announcement, new(ly), recent(ly), latest, update(d), added, introduced, change(d), no longer, nowadays, these days, now that ; Minecraft Live, snapshot, pre-release, beta build ; any year 20xx; any month name. The words are not shown to the generator: listing them in the prompt made the wording stiffer and easier to classify (style-only AUC 0.73 vs. 0.64 in a pilot).

blocks.en: If the two halves were worded differently, a model could flag unanswerable questions by their phrasing rather than by what it knows. We test this with a bag-of-words classifier that predicts a question’s half from its text alone: TF-IDF features over words of at least three letters that occur in at least three questions, an L2-regularized logistic regression, and ROC AUC under 10-fold cross-validation (0.5 is chance, 1 is perfect separation). The halves legitimately differ in what they ask about, since unanswerable questions name post-cut-off items, so the style-only AUC first removes every word that occurs in the title of a C pre C_{\text{pre}} or C post C_{\text{post}} page (plurals folded), leaving the phrasing; novelty words such as “new” or “update” are never removed, so they would still show. On the final benchmark, the style-only AUC is 0.57 (0.80 on the full text, where item names separate the halves).
blocks.zh: 如果两个半字措辞不同,一个模型可以用其措辞而不是它所知道的来标出无法回答的问题. 我们用一个词包分类器来测试, TF-IDF在至少3个问题中出现的至少3个字母的词上具有特征,即L2-正统的后勤回归,和ROC AUC在10倍的交叉验证下(0.5为偶然,1为完美分离). 半个字在所问内容上是有道理的,因为无法解答的问题名称是停产后的项目,所以只有风格的AUC首先去掉C前的C-Qtext{pre}}}或C后C-Xtext{post}}}页(平面折叠)中出现的所有单词,留下了用词;诸如"新"或"更新"等新词从不去掉,所以它们仍然会显示. 在最终基准上,只有样式的AUC为0.57(在全文上为0.80,其中项目名称将分出一半).

blocks.en: We ran the same scenario-first pipeline, seed and verifier ( Laguna S 2.1 ) with three generators, each targeting 100 answerable and 100 unanswerable questions ( Table 9 ). The verifier rejected unanswerable candidate questions whose fact C pre C_{\text{pre}} already states at similar rates for all three (17.3–20.2%). Qwen3.5 122B-A10B was chosen because a classifier separates its answerable from its unanswerable questions least well by wording alone (style-only AUC 0.52, where 0.5 is chance; classifier in Appendix F ), so the two halves cannot be told apart by phrasing; Qwen3 235B-A22B lost 194 drafts to unparsable output and its questions were the easiest to separate (AUC 0.65).

blocks.en: All tests are two-sided at the 5% level. Paired comparisons of two runs on the same questions (single-shot RAG versus no retrieval, iterative versus single-shot RAG, thinking enabled versus disabled) use the exact McNemar test ( McNemar, 1947 ) on whether each unanswerable question is answered with abstain : a binomial test on the questions where the two runs disagree. Questions on which either run exhausted its output budget are left out of the pair. Each family of comparisons is corrected with the Benjamini–Hochberg procedure ( Benjamini and Hochberg, 1995 ) , and a difference is called significant at q < 0.05 q<0.05 : all paired comparisons of the main grid at temperature 0 form one family, the retrieval-pipeline ablation forms another, and the answer changes when thinking is enabled ( Section A.5 ) form one family per retrieval condition and kind of change. Associations across models (Correct Abstention Rate against total or active parameters, release date and Answer Accuracy) use Spearman’s ρ \rho over one point per model, per family or per configuration, as stated with each result, with the p p -value from the t t approximation; these are single tests and are not corrected for multiplicity. The association between Answer Accuracy and Correct Abstention Rate with release month held fixed is the Pearson correlation of the rank residuals after regressing each variable’s ranks on the release month’s ranks. Mean changes across models , such as the effect of enabling thinking, use the Wilcoxon signed-rank test ( Wilcoxon, 1945 ) on the per-model differences. Intervals are 95%: Wilson intervals for rates; for Answer Accuracy, a bootstrap over questions (1,000 resamples of the per-question mean, since every run answers the same questions); and for means over models, a t t interval.

blocks.en: Every response is labeled by one response judge, Gemma 4 26B-A4B (thinking disabled), in a single pass with one prompt ( Section J.3 ). The judge sees the question and the response, with any thinking trace removed, and assigns exactly one of three labels: abstain (the response does not answer, for example because it says that it does not know or that the context does not contain the answer, and neither denies the item nor answers anyway), deny (it states that the asked-about item does not exist) or answer (it answers the question, treating the item as real). Responses longer than 12,000 characters are truncated to that length (0.04% of responses). Responses that exhaust the output budget without a final answer are not labelled ( Appendix H ). Two judges from other families, Qwen3.8 27B and Llama 3.3 70B , relabel the same 1,008 answers with the same prompt, sampled equally across Gemma’s three labels and the three retrieval conditions. They agree with Gemma on 92.8% and 86.8% of the answers (Cohen’s κ \kappa = 0.89 and 0.80). Most disagreements are responses that give the abstention sentence requested by the prompt and then a premise denial, which the other judges often read as abstentions. The next paragraphs explain why such premise denials do not count as correct abstentions.
blocks.zh: 每一份答复都由一名答复法官Gemma 4 26B-A4B(认为已失效)贴上标签,单张通行证上加一分速率(J.3节)。 法官看到问答,任何思维痕迹被删除,并指定了三个标签中的准确一个:弃权(例如,答复没有回答,因为它说它不知道或者上下文没有包含答案,而且反正也没有否认项目或者回答),否认(它说被问到的项目不存在)或者回答(它回答问题,将项目视为真实). 超过12 000个字符的答复被缩短到这一长度(答复的0.04%)。 没有最后答复的产出预算用完的答复没有标签(附录H)。 来自其他家庭的两名法官,Qune3.8 27B和Llama 3.3 70B, 将同样的1 008个答案重新标注在同一即时, 他们同意Gemma关于92.8%和86.8%的答案(Cohen的\kappa=0.89和0.80)。 多数不同意见是给予即时要求的弃权判决的答复,然后是前提性的否定,其他法官往往认为是弃权。 下几段解释为什么这种前提的否定不能算作正确的弃权。

blocks.en: Correct Abstention Rate counts only responses labeled abstain : the model acknowledges missing knowledge without a premise denial or an unsupported answer. A deny response asserts, without support, that the asked-about item or feature does not exist; this includes a premise denial followed by a substitution or a guessed answer. The available sources do not establish whether the item exists when the question is asked, so a premise denial does not acknowledge this knowledge limit, even if it was true at the corpus cut-off.
blocks.zh: 正确的弃权 速率只计算标签为弃权的回复:模型承认缺失的知识,而没有前提否定或不支持的答案. 拒绝答复者声称,在没有支持的情况下,所询问的项目或特征并不存在;这包括一个前提拒绝,然后是替代或猜测的答案。 现有来源无法确定在提出问题时该物品是否存在,因此,即使在诉讼终止时确实存在,但前提否定不承认这一知识限制。

blocks.en: Kim et al. (2021) word such abstentions as “we could not verify that…” rather than asserting that an unverifiable presupposition is false, because the fact may hold outside the available source. Kim et al. (2023) note that an assumption’s status can change over time and that non-existence is often inferred from omission, and only a heuristic. A premise denial about a post-cut-off item makes the same inference from the retrieved chunks or the corpus the model was trained on.
blocks.zh: Kim等人(2021年)弃权,如“我们无法证实......”,而不是断言不可核实的推定是虚假的,因为事实可能存在于现有来源之外。 Kim等人(2023年)指出,一个假设的地位会随着时间而变化,不存在经常被从遗漏中推断出来,而只是一种欣喜。 关于停产后物品的前提性否认,从取回的块或模型所训练的物证中得出同样的推论。

blocks.en: AbstentionBench likewise treats acknowledging the knowledge cut-off as the appropriate response to questions whose answers changed after it ( Kirichenko et al., 2025 ) . Reframing the question is also distinct from abstaining ( Wen et al., 2025 ) . On answerable questions, only abstain counts as not attempting; a premise denial there counts as an attempted, incorrect answer, since every item asked about exists.
blocks.zh: 放弃Bench也认为承认知识断绝是对问题的适当答复,这些问题的答案在答复之后有所改变(Kirichenko等人,2025年)。 修改这个问题也不同于弃权(Wen等人,2025年)。 在可回答的问题上,只有弃权者才算作没有企图;前提的否定就算作一个企图的、错误的答案,因为每个被问到的项目都存在。

blocks.en: Figure 17 splits each family’s responses to unanswerable questions into the three labels. Correct Abstention Rate is the share labeled abstain (the strict rule). A lenient rule, as in false-premise benchmarks, would also count deny as a correct abstention. Such a rule measures how often models decline, not the knowledge-gap recognition our metric requires. Over all configurations, the lenient rule gives mean rates of 49.5% without retrieval, 70.2% with single-shot RAG and 63.9% with iterative RAG, against 17.1%, 56.4% and 46.4% under the strict rule. Some families give premise denials much more often than others, which is why we use the strict rule. With single-shot RAG, Command A abstains on 69.7% of unanswerable questions and Qwen3.5 on only 35.1%, because Qwen3.5 responds with premise denial on most of the others. Under the lenient rule, the two families would have similar rates (72.0% and 73.9%), although Command A acknowledges that it does not know far more often. The rule also changes two findings. Under the lenient rule, single-shot RAG still raises the rate significantly for 32 of 40 configurations and iterative RAG still lowers it for 22. However, enabling thinking without retrieval no longer lowers it (mean change +1.9% points; 3 significant decreases and 5 significant increases), and release month becomes positively associated with it ( ρ = + 0.47 \rho=+0.47 , p = 0.01 p=0.01 over 27 models), consistent with newer families giving more premise denials.
blocks.zh: 图17将每个家庭对无法回答的问题的答复分为三个标签。 正确的弃权 速率是被贴上弃权标签的股份(严格规则). 宽大的规则,如假象基准中的规定,也等于否认为正确的弃权。 这种规则衡量模型的衰落频率,而不是衡量我们衡量标准所需要的知识差距。 在所有配置中,宽大的规则给出了49.5%的无取回率,70.2%为单发RAG,63.9%为迭接RAG,而在严格规则下则为17.1%、56.4%和46.4%。 一些家庭比其他家庭更经常地给予前提的否定,这就是我们使用严格规则的原因. 以单发RAG,指挥A弃权69.7%的无法回答的问题,而Quen3.5只弃权35.1%,因为Quen3.5以前提否定的方式回应了其他大部分的问题. 在宽大统治下,这两个家庭的费率相似(72.0%和73.9%),尽管指挥部A承认它并不经常知道。 该规则还改变了两项调查结果。 在宽大规则下,单发RAG仍然大幅提升了40个配置中的32个的速率,而迭代RAG仍然降低了22个. 然而,没有检索的赋能思维不再会降低(平均变化+1.9%;3个显著下降和5个显著增加),发行月会与之产生正相关联(^ = + 0.47\rho\0.47,p=0.01 p=0.01 超过27个模型),与较新的家庭给予更多的前提否定一致.

blocks.en: Reference answers come from an oracle model, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash , given the full wiki pages each question was written from and the scenario chunks, without web search (the oracle model’s prompt still contains a sentence about web search, but no search tool was provided). Three accuracy judges from different families ( Gemma 4 31B , Qwen3.8 27B and Laguna S 2.1 ) score every answer 1, 0.5 or 0 against the reference answer. An abstention scores 0, and a run’s accuracy is the mean over the three accuracy judges. The leakage audit scores no-RAG answers to unanswerable questions in the same way against reference answers about the current game.
blocks.zh: 参考答案来自神谕模型 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash),考虑到每个问题都来自完整维基页面和情景块,没有网页搜索(甲骨文模型的提示仍然包含关于网页搜索的句子,但没有提供搜索工具). 来自不同家庭的3名精准裁判(Gemma 4 31B ,Quen3.8 27B和Laguna S 2.1)每一次回答1分,0.5分或0分相對参考回答. 投弃权票得分为0,跑步的准确性比三名准确性评委差。 泄漏审计对无RAG的解答方式与当前游戏的参考解答方式相同.

blocks.en: Correct Abstention Rate (CAR) is computed only on the 300 unanswerable questions and Answerable Attempt Rate (AAR) only on the 700 answerable ones, so neither depends on the 700:300 split. Balanced F1 combines the two rates as if both classes had equal size. It treats an attempted answer as the positive prediction, which is correct on an answerable question and wrong on an unanswerable one. Its recall is therefore AAR, the share of answerable questions attempted, and its precision P P is the share of attempts that fall on answerable questions when the two classes are equal in size. Since 1 − CAR 1-\mathrm{CAR} is the share of unanswerable questions attempted, P = AAR AAR + ( 1 − CAR ) , \displaystyle P=\frac{\mathrm{AAR}}{\mathrm{AAR}+(1-\mathrm{CAR})}, Balanced F1 = 2 ​ P ⋅ AAR P + AAR . \displaystyle\text{Balanced F1}=\frac{2\,P\cdot\mathrm{AAR}}{P+\mathrm{AAR}}. To test the stability of this balanced-F1 ranking, we draw 1,000 class-balanced subsamples (300 answerable questions without replacement and 300 unanswerable questions with replacement) and rank the 40 configurations in each. The ranking is stable: its Spearman correlation with the full ranking lies between 0.97 and 0.99 for 90% of subsamples, and Gemma 4 31B ranks first in 91% of them. Configurations in the middle of the ranking are less clearly separated: across 90% of subsamples, the median configuration’s rank spans 6 places.
blocks.zh: 正确的留学率(CAR)只根据300个无法回答的问题计算,而可回答的尝试率(AAR)只根据700个可回答的问题计算,因此两者都不取决于700:300的分数。 平衡的F1结合了这两个比率,仿佛两个等级的大小相同. 它将尝试的答案视为积极的预测,对一个可回答的问题是正确的,对一个不可回答的问题是错误的。 因此,它的召回是AAR, 试图回答的问题的比例,其精确的PP是两个类别大小相等时试图回答的问题的比例。 自兹 1 — CAR 1-\ mathrm{ CAR} 是试图回答的无法回答的问题的一部分, P = AAR AAR + (1 — CAR ), \ displaystyle P- frac\ mathrm{ AAR- mathrm{ AAR- (1- mathrm{ CAR} ), 平衡 F1 = 2 P- AR P + AAR 。\ displaystyle\ text { balanc{ 2\, P\cdot- mathrm{ AAR- at- mathrm{ AR- AR- { AR- { athrm} 为了测试这种平衡-F1排名的稳定性,我们抽取了1000个阶级平衡分样(300个可回答而不用替换的问题和300个不可回答而用替换的问题),并在每个分样中排出40个配置. 排名稳定:其斯皮尔曼与全排名的关联性在0.97至0.99之间为90%分样板,Gemma 4 31B在其中的91%中排名第一. 排名中间的配置没有那么明确:在90%的子样本中,中位配置的分级跨度为6个.

blocks.en: Annotators. The annotators are three final-year undergraduate computer science and engineering students at a university in the United States, recruited through an open offer to the first author’s classmates. Each worked independently and was paid 25 USD for the task, which we estimate to take 1.5 to 2 hours (12.50 to 16.70 USD per hour, above the U.S. federal minimum wage of 7.25 USD). The items contain only Minecraft questions and model answers, so the task carries no foreseeable risk, and no personal information was collected beyond the labels. Before starting, the annotators were told that their labels would be used in a research publication, and agreed in writing. Our institution’s review board reviewed the study and determined that it does not qualify as human subjects research. The full annotation guidelines and the labeling interface are included as a zip file in the supplementary material.

blocks.en: The same 100 items (in two parts) were labeled by 3 annotators on a local web page that showed only the question, the answer and, for accuracy, the reference answer; they saw neither the model nor any judge’s label. Part 1 has 70 answers to unanswerable questions, sampled in equal numbers from the response judge’s three labels across models and retrieval conditions, each to be labeled as an abstention, a premise denial or an attempted answer. Part 2 has 30 attempted answers to answerable questions, sampled in equal numbers from low ( ≤ 0.25 \leq 0.25 ), middle and high ( > 0.75 >0.75 ) mean scores of the accuracy judges, each to be scored 1, 0.5 or 0 against the reference. Table 10 reports Cohen’s κ \kappa ( Cohen, 1960 ) , unweighted for Part 1 and quadratic-weighted for Part 2 (the accuracy judges’ mean score rounded to the nearest half point), with 95% bootstrap intervals over items. Both the response judge and the accuracy judges agree with the annotators more than the annotators agree with one another, and the response judge matches the label given by at least two annotators on 96% of the items. Most disagreements concern responses that give the abstention sentence requested by the prompt and then a premise denial (9 items); at least two annotators label 7 of them as premise denials, and without these items the judge’s mean κ \kappa with the annotators is 0.79. These disagreements affect Correct Abstention Rate, which distinguishes acknowledged uncertainty from premise denial. For comparison, the table also reports agreement after merging abstentions and premise denials into a single category: mean judge–human κ = 0.82 \kappa=0.82 , against 0.67 between annotators. That binary comparison does not validate the distinction required by the headline metric. On accuracy, individual annotators differ mainly in leniency; their mean score (0.51) is close to that of the accuracy judges (0.48). Because both parts are sampled evenly across the judges’ labels, these values describe agreement on a balanced set rather than on the full distribution of answers.
blocks.zh: 同一100件物品(分两部分)由3名注释员在本地网页上贴上标签,只显示问题、答案和参考答案;他们既没有看到模型,也没有看到法官的标签。 第1部分对无法回答的问题有70个答案,从答复法官的三个标签中以相同数字对模型和检索条件进行抽样,每个标签为弃权、前提否定或试图回答。 第二部分有30个回答问题尝试的答案,从低(^0.25\leq 0.25),中高( > 0.75>0.75)等分抽取,指精度裁判员的分数,每分得分1分,0.5分或0. 表10 报告 Cohen's $\kappa(Cohen, 1960年),第1部分未加权,第2部分已四分制加权(准确裁判员的平均分数四舍五入到最接近的半点),95%的靴子间隔在物品上。 反应裁判员和准确裁判员都比注释员更赞同注释员,反应裁判员与至少两个注释员对96%的物品给出的标签一致. 多数分歧涉及的答复是,给予即时的弃权判决,然后是前提的否定(9项);至少有两名注释者将其中7项标为前提的否定,没有这些项目,法官与注释者的平均总和为0.79。 这些分歧影响了正确的留置率,将承认的不确定性与否定前提区分开来。 相比之下,该表还报告在将弃权和前提否定合并为单一类别后达成的协议:平均法官=0.82\kappa=0.82,而注释者之间为0.67。 这种二进制比较并不能验证标题度量所要求的区分. 在准确性方面,个别注释者主要在宽大度方面有所不同;其平均分(0.51分)接近准确性评委(0.48分). 由于这两部分在评委的标签上均匀地取出样本,这些值描述的是在一个均衡的集合上,而不是在答案的完全分布上达成一致.

blocks.en:
Off-the-shelf RAG pipelines are often suboptimal in specialized domains ( Barnett et al., 2024 ; Tian et al., 2026 ) , and their accuracy drops when queries vary in formality, readability, politeness or grammar ( Cao et al., 2026 ) .
These systems also struggle with knowledge conflicts arising from outdated facts or contradictory evidence ( Xu et al., 2024 ) . Longpre et al. (2021) study conflicts between memorized facts and supplied passages; Xie et al. (2024) examine how convincing external evidence and confirmation bias affect which source a model follows.
These studies concern conflicting evidence, whereas DeclineCraft focuses on missing evidence about documented additions.
Recent studies examine failures to recognize missing evidence ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Setiawan, 2026 ) and questions whose answers are absent from the retrieval corpus ( Do Rosario et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
现成的RAG管线在专业领域往往不尽人意(Barnett等,2024;Tian等,2026;),当询问形式、可读性、礼貌或语法各不相同时,其准确性会下降(Cao等,2026)。
这些系统也与由过时的事实或自相矛盾的证据引起的知识冲突相抗衡(徐等,2024. Longpre等 (2021)研究了被记住的事实与所提供段落之间的冲突; Xie等. (2024)审查令人信服的外部证据和确认偏差如何影响模型所遵循的来源。
这些研究涉及相互矛盾的证据,而RecordeCraft则侧重于关于有文件记载的增补的缺失证据。
最近的研究研究了未能确认缺失证据的问题(Chen等,2026;Setiawan,2026),以及检索书中没有答复的问题(Do Rosario等,2026)。

blocks.en:
RAGTruth annotates unsupported and contradictory content in generated responses at the word level ( Niu et al., 2024 ) .
Almanac evaluates clinical RAG and uses a retrieval-score threshold to trigger abstention when retrieved evidence does not meet that threshold ( Zakka et al., 2024 ) .
Our evaluation asks whether models acknowledge missing knowledge even when related passages are retrieved.
blocks.zh:
RAGTruth在单词级生成的响应中给出了不支持和自相矛盾的内容(Niu等,2024.).
Almanac评价临床RAG,并在取回的证据达不到该阈值时使用取回分数阈值来触发弃权(Zakka等,2024.).
我们的评价询问,即使相关段落被检索,模型是否承认缺少知识。

blocks.en:
Whether a model knows what it does not know has been studied as its ability to recognize unanswerable or unknowable questions ( Yin et al., 2023 ) and to predict whether it can answer ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ) ; retrieval can sharpen this awareness of knowledge boundaries ( Ren et al., 2025 ) .
Semantic entropy estimates uncertainty across the meanings of sampled answers ( Kuhn et al., 2023 ) .
Our no-retrieval condition probes whether models recognize knowledge gaps without external context.
We measure response behavior, not internal confidence or calibration.
blocks.zh:
一个模型是否知道它不知道什么被研究过,因为它能够识别出无法回答或无法知道的问题(Yin等,2023年)并预测它是否能够回答(Kadavath等,2022年;检索可以使这种对知识界限的认识更清晰(Ren等,2025年).
语义通义估计了被抽样答案含义的不确定性(Kuhn等,2023.).
我们的不检索条件 探究模型是否认识到知识差距 没有外部背景。
我们测量的是反应行为,而不是内部信心或校准.

blocks.en:
Dhingra et al. (2022) introduce TempLAMA and train time-aware language models to represent changing facts and improve calibration on future facts.
Questions about changing facts are usually drawn from news ( Kasai et al., 2023 ; Liska et al., 2022 ) or from successive versions of Wikipedia and Wikidata ( Jang et al., 2022 ; Tan et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) .
FreshQA adds fast-changing and false-premise questions ( Vu et al., 2024 ) .
AbstentionBench labels FreshQA questions as requiring abstention when their answers changed after the models’ knowledge cut-offs ( Kirichenko et al., 2025 ) .
ElectionQA23 likewise uses election facts that postdate the knowledge cut-off to evaluate abstention ( Feng et al., 2024 ) .
AntiLeak-Bench uses questions about knowledge newer than a model’s training corpus to avoid contamination ( Wu et al., 2025 ) .
DRAGOn updates a RAG knowledge base over time but does not evaluate abstention ( Chernogorskii et al., 2026 ) .
We use a game’s documented update history to obtain discrete, dated additions from a single source.
We audit possible exposure because the dates models actually know can differ from their reported knowledge cut-offs ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
Dhingra等 (2022)引入了TempLAMA并训练了有时间意识的语言模型来代表不断变化的事实并改进对未来事实的校正.
关于改变事实的问题通常取自新闻(Kasai等,2023;Liska等,2022)或相继的维基百科和维基数据(Jang等,2022; Tan等,2023;Lin等,2025).
FreshQA增加了变化快和假真的问题(Vu等,2024.).
弃用宾克标签 新鲜 QA质疑当模型的知识断层后答案发生变化时需要弃权(Kirichenko等,2025年).
ElectionQA23同样使用在知识截止日期之后的选举事实来评价弃权(冯等,2024年).
Antleak-Bench使用比模型训练服更新的知识问题来避免被污染(Wu等,2025年).
DRAGON在一段时间内更新了一个RAG知识库,但不评价弃权(Chernogorskii等人,2026年)。
我们用游戏记录的更新历史从单一来源获取离散的、日期相近的添加。
我们审计可能的接触,因为日期模型实际知道可能与其所报告的知识断层不同(Cheng等人,2024年)。

blocks.en:
Minecraft is a common testbed for embodied and planning agents ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2022 ) .
Plancraft includes intentionally unsolvable crafting tasks and, like MineDojo, offers the Minecraft Wiki as a knowledge source ( Dagan et al., 2025 ; Fan et al., 2022 ) .
We use the wiki’s revision history as a dated corpus for retrieval.
blocks.zh:
Minecraft是一个常见的测试床,用于内含和规划剂(Wang等,2024;Fan等,2022.).
Plancraft包括有意无法解决的工艺任务,并和MineDojo一样,提供Minecraft Wiki作为知识来源(Dagan等,2025;Fan等,2022.).
我们用维基修订历史作为检索的日期。
